hooks.name: a11y-review-on-component-save
hooks.description: Review each saved component for keyboard access, labels and contrast

action.prompt: A component under src/components/ was just saved. Using .kiro/skills/frontend-a11y/SKILL.md, review only that file for: every control reachable and operable by keyboard with a visible focus style; every input with a visible <label> and errors tied by aria-describedby; buttons named by their text or aria-label; status changes (loading, copied, not found) announced through an aria-live region; colour never the only signal; text colours from tailwind.config.js (ink, ink-2, ink-3 meet 4.5:1 on white and mist); hit areas at least 40px; and no fixed widths that would scroll horizontally at 390px. Fix what you find, and list anything you could not fix.
